summary: This study looks at how different types of rice affect blood sugar levels in adults with prediabetes or type 2 diabetes. Participants will eat different kinds of functional rice varieties, such as low glycaemic index rice. The trial is sponsored by the Institute for Human Development and Potential (IHDP), Singapore, and aims to enroll 225 people. The status of the trial is Not yet recruiting.

facts.sponsor: Institute for Human Development and Potential (IHDP), Singapore
